Symbol study · 14

Creative work,
in motion.

A broad brushstroke sweeps into an open arch and resolves into a tapered finish. Its loose inner curl brings a hand-drawn quality without locking the mark to a fixed number of apps.

Open brush loop · tapered finish

The creative current

The outer sweep itself narrows to the finish, so the point belongs to the brushstroke rather than reading as an added tail. The violet-to-coral gradient remains independent from the implementation roster.
